title: Nighttime accidents
edit_notes:
- **VO:** soft, warm US female bedtime voice, close to the mic: gentler than the other ads, but keep the pace up, since the script fills the full 60 s.
- **Captions:** white sentence case with a soft shadow, 2–4 words at a time, about 75% of the way down the frame.
- **Music:** gentle music box or celesta. A soft fairy-light twinkle, a fizzle when the signal dies (shot 9), a warm "ping" when the bulb lights (shot 13).
- **Stop-motion feel:** if Wan comes out too smooth, export at 12 fps in CapCut, which gives the choppy handmade look.
